teaser: The sound of a stapler going again and again, closing another pile of signed pages — that is the small machinery around life path 8 crossed with INTJ. You are an 8, built to take hold of money, power, and authority, and an INTJ, who draws the plan before the first move is made. Here the hunger for command meets a mind that already has the long chess line worked out. What is particular is not ambition alone — plenty of numbers want that — but ambition married to a blueprint, so each gain gets filed instead of spent.
